_comment: Coordinator agent. The multiagent.agents ids are placeholders: fleet/bin/deploy.py fills them in from the sub-agent ids it just created (create) or from the ids recorded in fleet/cloud.md (update). Never hand-edit them here — edit fleet/cloud.md and re-run deploy.py. `system` is the literal text of AGENT.md at the repo root, loaded by deploy.py.
name: coworld-builder-coordinator
description: coworld-builder: the coordinator. Runs the hourly heartbeat, claims a Coworld Idea, drives phases 00-90, delegates to the six sub-agents.
